module rtlpp_08922 (
  input wire clk,
  input wire resend,
  input wire advance,
  output wire [15:0] command,
  output reg finished
);

  reg [15:0] sreg;
  reg [7:0] address = 8'b0;

  assign command = sreg;

  always @(*) begin
    if (sreg == 16'hFFFF)
      finished = 1'b1;
    else
      finished = 1'b0;
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (resend == 1'b1) begin
      address <= 8'b0;
    end
    else if (advance == 1'b1) begin
      address <= address + 1;
    end
    
    case (address)
      8'h00 : sreg <= 16'h1280;
      8'h01 : sreg <= 16'h1280;
